about_the_game:
B.I.D. – Boss in Diapers is a hilarious yet strategic multiplayer card game where baby mobsters take playtime way too seriously.

Set in a colorful daycare, 2–4 players create their own mini mafias, outsmart rivals, and fight their way to the boss chair!

🎴 Game Modes

Each mode offers a unique take on classic card games with a baby-mafia twist:

B.I.D. — The signature mode of bluffs, offers, and pure unpredictability.

Baby Bluff — A faster, riskier, and laugh-filled spin on card battles!

(More themed modes coming soon.)

👶 Customizable Baby Mobsters

Style your little boss with tiny suits, pacifiers, fedoras, and ridiculous sunglasses!

Decorate your high chair with accessories and toys that show off your personality — every baby can be a boss.

🏫 Daycare Setting & The Teacher

Every match takes place in a vibrant daycare. It looks innocent… until someone breaks the rules!

That’s when the Teacher shows up — picking up crying babies and restoring order, but never stopping the fun.

💬 Play With Friends

Play online with 2–4 players, bluff your way to victory, and laugh together as chaos unfolds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
